title: Import-time schema construction in mlflow.types.responses must suppress its expected union-inference logs
answers: importing mlflow.types.responses prints union type warnings in my logs
custom root logging gets noise on import of mlflow responses types
Union type hint is inferred as AnyType warning appears when importing MLflow
how do I silence expected type-inference warnings at module import in MLflow
body:
Symptom: Applications with custom root logging see "Union type hint ... is inferred as AnyType, and MLflow doesn't validate the data against its element types." when they import mlflow.types.responses, though nothing is wrong.
Root cause: mlflow/types/responses.py builds ResponsesAgentRequest/response schemas at module level via _infer_schema_from_type_hint, which logs those expected messages on logger "mlflow.types.type_hints".
Fix pattern: keep the module-level block in a `with` that combines MlflowEventsAndWarningsBehaviorGlobally with suppress_logs("mlflow.types.type_hints", filter_regex=...), where the regex (_EXPECTED_UNION_INFERENCE_WARNING) matches the two exact messages anchored with ^ and $.
Constraints: Applies only to schema construction at import; do not widen the regex or drop the logger name, because ordinary union-inference warnings elsewhere must stay visible. If the message text in mlflow/types/type_hints.py changes, the regex must change with it or the noise returns silently.
applies: Module-level schema construction in mlflow/types/responses.py; any new import-time type inference added there.
says: Importing response types pollutes application startup logs with union type warnings.

Suppress benign type hint warnings when importing agent response data models.
